changelog.title: Arena VS Mode
changelog.description: Competitive team-based CTF battles. Form teams, race for flags, and watch the live scoreboard as you outpace your opponents.

changelog.title: 10 Arena Boxes
changelog.description: The Arena grows to 10 offensive challenges — SQL injection, XSS, command injection, privilege escalation, crypto, NoSQL, file upload, deserialization, and SSRF.

changelog.title: Assessment Integration
changelog.description: Arena boxes now report to the instructor analytics pipeline. Flag captures, hints, and completions are tracked for classroom visibility.

changelog.title: Host Error Detector
changelog.description: A floating diagnostic panel monitors runtime errors in real time. Admin-gated with Copy Log and Export for easy bug reporting.

changelog.title: Co-Op & Multiplayer
changelog.description: Solo, Co-Op, and VS modes — three ways to experience every Arena box.
